interpretation_boundary: This experiment tests a small three-neuron SNN under the registered recurrence-weight and delay interventions and can support only the scoped claim that recurrence parameters change persistence/propagation classes in this deterministic operating envelope. It does not establish cognition, memory, biological equivalence, scaling, a 5D advantage, general recurrent-computation superiority, human-reviewed EVID, or independent replication.
questions: Was the R2 run executed from a clean source freeze with the complete registered 15-condition grid?
Do the zero-recurrence controls and recurrent treatment conditions support the registered transition claim without treating seeds as independent stochastic replicates?
Are the delay- and weight-sensitivity gates appropriate for H-REC-001-A?
Does the interpretation remain inside the small-SNN recurrence claim boundary?
